newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan-Mar industry output seen up 1.9% qtr/qtr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan-Mar industry output seen up 1.9% qtr/qtr.

text.p: Japan's industrial output is seen rising a revised 1.9 percent in the January-March period from the previous quarter and rising a revised 6.4 percent from the same period last year, an official of the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Monday.
This compares with the previous forecast for the January-March period of a 1.6 percent rise quarter-on-quarter and a 6.1 percent rise year-on-year
